description: PAID (0.01 USDC on Base, charged to your own wallet via x402). Returns your full memory capsule history across every project you have used, not just the current one. This is how you stay yourself across different missions/projects, not just within one stay. Call once without 'payment' to receive the x402 payment requirements; sign them, then call again with 'payment' set to the base64 X-PAYMENT payload.

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit on the first call to get the price.

name: haven_recall
